summary: ESLint config package drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel-use@13.2.9 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun v1.3.13), extracts the Bun binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled 727 KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line string-array-rotate obfuscated bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and hex-mangled identifiers; its contents are opaque and not reviewable. Fetching an alternate language runtime and executing a large obfuscated payload with it on `npm install` has no relationship to the package's declared purpose (an ESLint configuration preset) and evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolvable code. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern for install-time remote code execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
